name: get_file_tree
description: Get the file tree of an indexed repository, optionally filtered by path prefix. Results are capped at max_files (default 500) to prevent token overflow; use path_prefix to scope large trees.

repo.description: Repository identifier (owner/repo or just repo name)

include_summaries.description: Include file-level summaries in the tree nodes

max_files.description: Maximum number of files to return (default 500). When truncated, response includes total_file_count and a hint to use path_prefix.
